name: Gaian Locality Optimization
definition: A two-stage procedure (online and offline) to optimize data access locality in distributed Point-Based Differentiable Rendering (PBDR) by assigning points to GPUs and images to GPUs to minimize communication.
summary: Gaian Locality Optimization is a two-stage procedure that minimizes communication overhead in distributed rendering by using Z-order sorting and graph partitioning to assign points and images to GPUs.
